data_availability_text: Data availabilityThe harmonized GNPC data used to generate these findings were provided to consortium members in June 2024 and will be made available for public request by the AD Data Initiative in July 2025. Members of the global research community will be able to access the metadata and place a data use request via the AD Discovery Portal (https://discover.alzheimersdata.org/). Access is contingent upon adherence to the GNPC Data Use Agreement and the Publication Policies.
